_what: Commit identifiers recorded in the provenance line of result files, mapped to the commit that carries the same code in the history as it stands now.
_why: The history was rewritten twice on 2026-09-17: once to take an environment variable name out of every commit that mentioned it, and once to drop the measured databases, which are distributed as a release of the shared dataset repository instead. Both rewrites preserved every commit and their order, and neither changed a single file that a run had read, but both changed every identifier after the point they touched. Without this table a recorded number names a commit that no longer exists. A third rewrite on 2026-10-04 replaced the absolute path of the development checkout, which sixteen probe artifacts had recorded (a campaign ledger's jar argument and the results directory of the definitions suite), with the same path relative to the repository root. It changed no file a run had read and no measured value; COMMIT_MAP.tsv lists every identifier it changed.
_how_verified: The two rewrites preserved commit count and order (54 and 54; 80 and 80), so each old identifier maps to the commit at the same position. Checked by comparing subject lines at both ends and at four interior positions of each rewrite, including the one commit whose message was deliberately reworded -- an alignment off by one would have placed that message elsewhere. The 2026-10-04 rewrite kept 157 commits in the same order, the first 61 with their identifiers; message, author and dates are equal on all 157 pairs, and each of the 1062 changed tree entries is one of 156 blobs whose only difference is the removed path prefix.
